observation: Inherited or generated inventories and internally consistent exports can omit real source profiles, dimensions, operations or functional fixtures.
cause: Circular requirement checks, legacy cropping, unverified transforms and pattern/owner classification can hide actual source content.
proposed_rule: Independently inventory original physical and annotation owners; compare complete pilots and actual exports; verify full connected profiles, source paint, current mapping, isolated operation tips and glyph ink. Transfer verified prevention into Create while keeping independent Check.
evidence: Bundled compact historical provenance; optional, not runtime dependency
qualification: Scoped instruction and decision transfer: one correct export and four actual export defects independently classified. No renderer implementation or new customer acceptance claimed.
